scope: Seven read-endpoint preflights on actual Forge-X, plus history pages, filters and all 266 jobs. This is not an exhaustive parity audit.

code_bugs_fixed.observed: SQL NULL became numeric zero in the earlier and first optimized builds. Two affected records appeared in the first 20; seven exist in the complete copied history.
code_bugs_fixed.fix: f34d601 preserves SQLite NULL before reading a double. Seven final ARM response comparisons match actual Moonraker, including before-filter exclusion of the seven unfinished rows.

identity_and_capabilities_kept.reason: Phobos identifies as API 1.5.0 and phobos. Forge-X reports API 1.4.0 and an unknown software version. The newer compatibility target is retained.
Phobos retains its documented Python stub and does not impersonate the installed CPython 3.11.10 runtime. Other system-info values matched inside the chroot.

The minimal probe config leaves update_manager and octoprint_compat registered in phobos; Forge-X omits them. No update remotes are configured. Implementations remain available. Production's full Forge-X component set is a different fixture.

Phobos reports these supported defaults even when the older Forge-X minimal configuration does not read or report them. They are retained capability/default-reporting differences; no parser option was removed to match omission.

intentional_policy_kept.reason: Phobos deliberately hides the forbidden authorized_users namespace from the public list. The older Forge-X lists that name. Credential reads remain forbidden, and the existing security policy/tests were preserved. Namespace ordering is not compared as an ordered sequence.

environment.reason: Moonraker warns that the private probe config and empty gcodes directories differ from Klippy's live /opt/config and /data paths. These separate probe directories protect production. Phobos with validation disabled returns no such warnings. No live paths were changed to suppress them.

other_deliberate_limits: See docs/releases/v0.2.1.md: CAN empty-list fallback, Python stub, optional component registration, no-op host reboot/shutdown, and excluded full Jinja2/LDAP/Apprise remain unchanged.
